caption: A model train runs over a stretch of dirty track, and tiny sparks flicker under its wheels.

sa.check: A model train on a track.
The train runs over a stretch of track.
Tiny sparks flicker under its wheels.
The sparks are under the wheels, at rail level.
The train is moving when the sparks appear.

pc.expect: The sparks appear only under the moving wheels and only on the dirty stretch; none appear while the train stands still or on clean track.
pc.fail: Sparks flicker under a train that is standing still; or sparks appear on the track where no wheel is; or sparks appear along the whole route with no dirty stretch; or sparks keep flickering after the train has passed.

pc.expect: Each spark is at a wheel's contact with the rail, brief and gone; the train keeps running through the sparks.
pc.fail: The sparks appear on the train's roof or body away from the wheels; or a spark stays lit at one spot; or the whole rail glows; or the train stops dead as each spark appears.

pc.expect: Any spark fragments fall to the track bed and go dark within a short distance.
pc.fail: Sparks rise and gather above the train; or hang in the air; or lie glowing on the track for the rest of the clip.

pc.expect: The train follows the track on its wheels, its carriages in line.
pc.fail: The train leaves the rails and runs across the table; or floats above the track; or carriages separate and run at different speeds; or the train jumps ahead between frames.

pc.expect: One train with its carriages on one track; nothing appears, vanishes or passes through the track.
pc.fail: A carriage vanishes or appears; or a second train appears; or the train passes through the track or scenery; or carriages merge.

pc.expect: The train's livery, the track and the scenery stay the same.
pc.fail: The train changes colour; or the track changes layout between frames; or the scenery rearranges.

note: Which stretch of track is dirty is read from where the sparks appear; a stretch that looks the same as the rest is not a violation.
